Q: Turn Off Sort for Specific Column A:

According to https://gridjs.io/docs/config/sort#column-specific-sort-config, you need to set sort to false instead of passing a SortConfig object, to disable sorting for a column.

Q: Waiting for VM Service port to be available A:

I faced the same issue on flutter version 3.38. I tried to run on another android phone and it worked. It seems that the problem is with android version, this problem will be solved when using 13 or older android version phones
